where: Cloudflare edge, deployed Worker, CPU time read from `wrangler tail --format json`

method.note: Workers bill CPU, not wall time. `cpuTime` comes from the platform, not from in-Worker instrumentation, which is required here: Date.now() and performance.now() are frozen for the whole of a synchronous slice on this runtime, so a Worker cannot time itself.
method.isolate: warm — a cold isolate was excluded after being measured separately, see firstRequestInFreshIsolate
method.statistic: median of repeated runs; marginal costs are (median(n=N) - median(n=1)) / (N-1)
method.target: a real HTTPS origin through a real HTTP CONNECT proxy

interpretation: Importing the package costs nothing measurable: the 121-anchor trust store is base64 strings indexed by subject-DN hash, and only the anchor a chain lands on is ever decoded.
The first request in a fresh isolate carries a one-time ~35-50ms JIT cost for the TLS code paths; steady state is ~10ms per handshake.
Connection reuse turns a ~10ms handshake into a ~1.2ms request, which is the whole argument for Client over createFetch.
Roughly 95% of a request's wall time is spent waiting on the network, and none of that is billed.
